title: FACS-GAL isolation of β-galactosidase expressing cells from mid gestation mouse embryos
protocol: Dissect out mouse embryos in DMEM + 25 mM HEPES.
Incubate embryos in 0.3 mM chloroquine diluted in DMEM + 25 mM HEPES containing 5% FCS at 37°C, 5% CO2 for 30 minutes.
Rinse embryos three times in PBS.
Incubate embryos in 0.25% trypsin in PBS for approximately 30 minutes.
Dissociate embryos into a single cell suspension by trituration every 5-10 minutes using plastic pipettes.
Spin down the cell suspension at 300 x g for 3 minutes.
Resuspend cells in pre-warmed 50 μM CMDFG, 200 μM verapamil in 5% FCS/DMEM + 25 mM HEPES and incubate for 30 minutes at 37°C, 5% CO2.
Dilute cells to approximately 1-3 million cells/mL with 5% FCS/DMEM + 25 mM HEPES.
Add 1 mM PETG to stop the reaction.
Add 1.5 μM propidium iodide to identify dead cells.
Flow sort as soon as possible using standard procedures.
Collect sorted cells immediately at 300 x g for 4 minutes after FACS.
Resuspend the collected cells in 800 μl Trizol (Gibco BRL).
Add 250 μg/ml glycogen (Roche) or 50 μg/mL Glycoblue (Ambion) as an RNA co-precipitant to improve yield.
Homogenize the cells by passing them twice through a 25-gauge needle.
Store homogenized cells at -80°C, or process immediately using standard techniques.
